# Surfing ESA

> Surfing ESA offers surf lessons in El Salvador, surfboard rentals in El Salvador and surf experiences in El Salvador, based in La Libertad and led by founder and head coach Josselyn "Joss" Alabi, an international SUP and surf athlete.

## What we do
Surfing ESA is a water sports company based in La Libertad, El Salvador, Central America. It teaches people of all ages and skill levels to surf and to stand up paddle, rents surfboards and SUP boards, and designs and operates water experience programs for hotels, resorts and companies. Every lesson includes gear, beach access and a professional instructor. Services are offered in English and Spanish.

## Services
- One-on-one lesson with transport: 1-hour private surf or SUP lesson anywhere in El Salvador, with round-trip transport and full gear. From $125.
- Surf lessons in El Salvador, one-on-one in La Libertad: 1-hour private lesson at the surf spot, beach access, instructor and full gear included. From $85.
- Group lessons: surf (1 to 3 people), SUP surf (1 to 2 people) and SUP (1 to 4 people). Group rate on request.
- Special monthly rate: recurring lessons all month with preferred pricing.
- Surfboard rentals in El Salvador: soft top boards for beginners and high-performance boards for progressing surfers.
- Surf experiences in El Salvador: guided surf and SUP surf sessions for travelers, groups, hotels and companies.
- SUP rentals: board and paddle, or paddle only.
- Hotel and resort water experience management: outsourced guest water programs (instructors, equipment, operations).
- Corporate events, team building and activations: surf competitions, sponsorships and ocean-side brand activations.
- Coming soon: sailing and rowing in partnership with national federations (waitlist open).
- Special prices for Salvadorans.

## Problems we solve
- "I want to learn to surf in El Salvador but do not know where to go." Surfing ESA chooses the right spot for your level and the conditions of the day, then shares all the details.
- "I do not have a board or gear." Lessons include full gear, and boards can be rented.
- "I need transport from my hotel or city." The one-on-one lesson with transport picks you up anywhere in El Salvador.
- "Our hotel or company needs a safe, professional water program." Surfing ESA designs, operates and advises on programs built on elite safety standards.

## Who it is for
Travelers and residents in El Salvador of any age and level who want to surf or SUP, from first-timers to progressing surfers; hotels, resorts and companies that want water experiences for guests or teams.

## Proof
- Founder Josselyn Alabi: 10+ years competing, 7 SUP World Championships, 2 Olympic cycles, 34+ medals and trophies, national team member in rowing, SUP surfing and sailing.
- Gold medal at the Bolivarian Games; ambassador of Marca País El Salvador for Salvadoran sports; sports success recognition from the Presidency of El Salvador.
- Every lesson booked helps fund Mar de Sueños, a social foundation for coastal youth, and connects to Waves Well SUP retreats.

# Full content

## About Surfing ESA
At Surfing ESA we believe water has the power to transform the way we explore, learn and connect with the world around us.

We create safe, authentic and memorable water experiences for people of all ages and skill levels, guided by internationally experienced instructors who are passionate about sharing everything the water has taught them. From private and group lessons in surfing, paddle boarding, sailing and rowing, to curated experiences, events and hospitality partnerships, our purpose is to help more people discover the water through the highest standards of safety, professionalism and genuine human connection.

Because every great experience begins long before stepping into the water, and stays with you long after you leave it. Tagline: Experience. Explore. Engage.

## Founder and head coach: Josselyn "Joss" Alabi
Josselyn Alabi is an international athlete in surf and stand up paddle (SUP), an entrepreneur, and a firm believer in the transformative power of sports. With over a decade of competing at the highest level, she realized that medals come at a certain point along the journey, but the experience and the path to them are what truly transform you. With that vision, she founded Surfing ESA, a company dedicated to creating safe, professional and memorable aquatic experiences, raising the standard of water sports in El Salvador.

Key numbers (as published on the site): 10+ years competing; 2 Olympic cycles (quadrennia); 7 SUP World Championships; 34+ medals and trophies; national team member in 3 sports (rowing, SUP surfing, sailing); still pursuing the Olympic Games dream.

Achievements and recognitions:
- Gold medal at the Bolivarian Games.
- Appointed ambassador of Marca País El Salvador (the country brand) for Salvadoran sports.
- Sports success recognition from the Presidency of El Salvador.
- National team member in rowing, surfing and sailing.

Josselyn also runs Waves Well (waveswellretreats.com), international SUP surf retreats built around performance and personal growth, and founded Mar de Sueños, a social foundation that empowers coastal youth in El Salvador through sport.

## Surf lessons (details and prices in USD)
Every lesson includes gear, beach access and a professional instructor: one hour of pure ocean immersion in El Salvador. Special prices for Salvadorans.

1. One-on-one, anywhere in El Salvador, transport included. From $125. Round-trip transport from anywhere in El Salvador, 1-hour private instruction, full gear included.
2. One-on-one at the surf spot, La Libertad. From $85 (most popular). 1-hour private instruction, beach access included, instructor and full gear included.
3. Group lessons: surf, SUP surf and SUP. Ask for the group rate. Surf (1 to 3 people), SUP surf (1 to 2 people), SUP (1 to 4 people).

Monthly programs: training all month? Recurring lessons come with a special monthly rate and a plan built around your goals. Book on WhatsApp.

Coming soon: sailing and rowing, in partnership with national federations. Join the waitlist by email at info@surfingesa.com.

## Rentals and experiences
- Surfboard rentals in El Salvador: soft top boards for beginners, and high-performance boards for progressing surfers.
- SUP rentals: board and paddle, or paddle-only rentals for calm water exploring or SUP surfing.

## For business
Surfing ESA designs, operates and advises on water-experience programs built on elite safety standards and world-class execution.
1. Hotel and resort water experience management: full outsourced management of your guest water program (instructors, equipment and operations), tailored to your brand. Managed on-site operations, branded guest experiences, one-time setup advisory available.
2. Corporate events, team building and activations: from concept to execution, surf competitions, sponsorships and ocean-side activations that connect your brand to real experiences. Team building programs, competitions and sponsorships, full event operations.
To request a consultation, message Surfing ESA on WhatsApp (+503 7800 9672) or email info@surfingesa.com.

## Beyond the waves: Mar de Sueños and Waves Well
Every lesson booked helps fund Mar de Sueños, the social foundation empowering coastal youth through sport, and connects to Waves Well, international SUP retreats built around performance and personal growth. Donations: message on WhatsApp.

## Merch
Surfing ESA "beyond the waves" merchandise: surf poncho, rash guard, cap, white and navy t-shirts, and canvas, yellow and navy tote bags. Order on WhatsApp.

## Frequently asked questions
### How much are surf lessons in El Salvador?
Private surf lessons with Surfing ESA start at $85 for one hour at the surf spot in La Libertad, with instructor, beach access and full gear included. A private lesson with round-trip transport from anywhere in El Salvador starts at $125. Group lessons for surf, SUP surf and SUP have their own group rate, and Salvadorans get special prices.

### Can I rent a surfboard in El Salvador?
Yes. Surfing ESA rents surfboards in El Salvador: soft top boards for beginners and high-performance boards for progressing surfers. We also rent SUP boards with paddle, or the paddle only. Message us on WhatsApp to check availability.

### What surf experiences do you offer in El Salvador?
Besides private and group surf lessons, we run monthly training programs, SUP surf sessions, and surf experiences for hotels, resorts and companies, from guest water programs to team building and surf events. Every experience is led by internationally experienced instructors with safety first.

### Where do the lessons take place?
The location depends on your experience level, goals and the conditions of the day. We’ll start by getting to know you and understanding your skill level, then select the best location for your session. Once everything is confirmed, we’ll share all the details so you can simply show up and enjoy the water.

### What should I bring?
We recommend wearing comfortable swimwear, along with a T-shirt or rashguard and board shorts for extra comfort and protection. This helps reduce skin irritation and gives you greater confidence and freedom of movement in the water. Don’t forget a towel, sunscreen and plenty of hydration.

### Can I bring my own equipment?
Absolutely. Some of our services already include equipment, but you’re welcome to bring your own as long as it’s appropriate for your skill level, the activity and the goals of the session.

### How do I book a lesson or experience?
It’s simple. Choose the sport or experience you’d like to book, select from the available times and complete your payment. Once payment is confirmed, your time slot and equipment are reserved exclusively for you.

### How do I pay?
Once you’re ready to book, we’ll send you a secure payment link. We currently accept Visa and Mastercard.

### Can I cancel my lesson or experience?
Yes. Because all sessions are reservation-based and require us to secure instructors and equipment in advance, the following cancellation policy applies:
4 days before: 75% refund 3 days before: 50% refund 2 days before: 25% refund 1 day before: Non-refundable

### What happens if weather or water conditions are not suitable?
Your safety always comes first. If weather or water conditions are not suitable for the activity, the session will be rescheduled, not cancelled. Our team will contact you to coordinate a new date so you can enjoy the experience under the right conditions.

### What ages can participate in lessons and experiences?
Age requirements vary depending on the sport, activity and level of risk involved. Children always participate one-on-one with an instructor for added safety and personalized guidance. We’ll recommend the most appropriate experience based on their age, ability and comfort level in the water.

## How to book
Message Surfing ESA on WhatsApp (+503 7800 9672) for the fastest response, or use the booking form on the website. Payment is by secure payment link (Visa and Mastercard).

## Location
La Libertad, El Salvador (Central America). Lessons can take place at different spots in El Salvador depending on level and conditions; the one-on-one lesson with transport covers pickup anywhere in the country.
